message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, missing) across all sides. A commonly cited breakdown is:

| Side | Casualties |
|------|------------|
| French & allied forces (including German contingents) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~22,000 |

These figures are estimates; exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but the consensus places total losses in the mid‑20s of thousands.
